ASHWATER.description: exhaust any number of cards in your hand.
ASHWATER.name: Ashwater
ASHWATER.zh_description: 消耗手牌中任意数量的卡牌。

ATTACK_POTION.description: choose 1 of 3 distinct Attack cards generated from your character card pool (may skip); the card is added to hand and is free this turn.
ATTACK_POTION.name: Attack Potion
ATTACK_POTION.zh_description: 从角色卡池生成 3 张不同攻击牌中选 1 张（可跳过）；加入手牌，本回合免费。

BEETLE_JUICE.description: apply ShrinkPower 4 to the target. ShrinkPower: the owner's attack damage is ×0.7 (−30%); 1 stack is removed at the end of the owner's turn; negative amount = infinite, no decay. With 4 stacks: −30% attack damage for 4 of its turns.
BEETLE_JUICE.name: Beetle Juice
BEETLE_JUICE.zh_description: 对目标施加 ShrinkPower 4 层。ShrinkPower：拥有者攻击伤害 ×0.7（−30%）；拥有者回合结束移除 1 层；层数为负数时为无限持续、不衰减。4 层 = 其 4 个回合内攻击伤害 −30%。

BLESSING_OF_THE_FORGE.description: Upgrade every upgradable card in your hand for the combat (combat-scoped — reverts after combat, Armaments-class). LIVE run-38: Defend 5→8 confirmed live on a lethal-intent boss turn (8+8=16 block vs 17 incoming); Molten Fist 10→14 likewise. Spend on the turn hand density is highest / incoming is lethal — not a permanent deck investment.
BLESSING_OF_THE_FORGE.name: Blessing of the Forge
BLESSING_OF_THE_FORGE.zh_description: 为本场战斗升级手牌中所有可升级卡（战斗内限定——战斗后还原，Armaments 同类）。run-38 实时：致命意图 Boss 回合确认 Defend 5→8（8+8=16 挡对 17 来袭）；熔岩拳 10→14 同理。在手牌密度最高/来袭致命的回合使用——不是永久牌库投资。

BLOCK_POTION.description: Gain 12 Block on use. Uncommon-class reserve potion for lethal-intent turns and boss gates. LIVE run-40: consumed Decimillipede T4 — 12 + Evil Eye 16 (Unmovable-doubled) = 28 vs 32 incoming at 34 HP. Potion-sourced block does NOT double with Unmovable (card-block only).
BLOCK_POTION.name: Block Potion
BLOCK_POTION.source: md:potions.md:L18; md:potions_zh.md:L18; codex:potions/BLOCK_POTION; run-40 live fold 2026-09-18

BLOOD_POTION.description: Heal for 20% of your Max HP.
BLOOD_POTION.name: Blood Potion

BOTTLED_POTENTIAL.description: move your hand into the draw pile, shuffle the draw pile, draw 5.
BOTTLED_POTENTIAL.name: Bottled Potential
BOTTLED_POTENTIAL.zh_description: 将手牌移入抽牌堆，洗牌，抽 5 张。

CLARITY.description: draw 1; apply ClarityPower 3 — draw +1 card at the start of each of your next 3 turns (decrements at your turn start).
CLARITY.name: Clarity Extract
CLARITY.zh_description: 抽 1 张；获得 ClarityPower 3——接下来 3 回合开始时各多抽 1 张（每次己方回合开始递减）。

COLORLESS_POTION.description: choose 1 of 3 distinct Colorless-pool cards (may skip); add to hand, free this turn.
COLORLESS_POTION.name: Colorless Potion
COLORLESS_POTION.zh_description: 从无色卡池生成 3 张不同卡牌中选 1 张（可跳过）；加入手牌，本回合免费。

COSMIC_CONCOCTION.description: add 3 distinct upgraded Colorless-pool cards to hand.
COSMIC_CONCOCTION.name: Cosmic Concoction
COSMIC_CONCOCTION.zh_description: 向手牌加入 3 张不同的升级版无色池卡牌。

CUNNING_POTION.name: Cunning Potion
CUNNING_POTION.zh_description: 向手牌加入 3 张升级版 Shiv。

CURE_ALL.description: gain 1 Energy; draw 2 cards. Despite the name this is NOT a heal — burst/dig class potion; run-41 live confirmed +1e and 2 draws on a boss kill turn. Any archive note claiming healing is wrong.
CURE_ALL.name: Cure All
CURE_ALL.zh_description: 获得 1 能量；抽 2 张牌。名称像治疗但**不是治疗**——爆发/挖牌类（+1能+抽2）；任何「CureAll 治疗」注记均为错误。

DEXTERITY_POTION.name: Dexterity Potion
DEXTERITY_POTION.play_notes: run-39 live: +2 Dexterity on use; Defend 5→7 live under Dex. Bowlbug T4: Dex+Defend×2 = 14 block vs HEADBUTT 15 (one short of IMBALANCED full-block stun).

DISTILLED_CHAOS.description: Play the top 3 cards of your Draw Pile.
DISTILLED_CHAOS.name: Distilled Chaos
DISTILLED_CHAOS.zh_description: 打出抽牌堆顶的 3 张牌。

DROPLET_OF_PRECOGNITION.description: choose 1 card from your draw pile; add it to hand.
DROPLET_OF_PRECOGNITION.name: Droplet of Precognition
DROPLET_OF_PRECOGNITION.zh_description: 从抽牌堆选 1 张牌加入手牌。

DUPLICATOR.description: apply DuplicationPower 1 — the next card you play this turn is played 1 extra time; removed at end of turn. DUPLICATION_POWER:1 visible same state read on use; the next attack resolves twice (e.g. Bash+ doubled); power gone at end of turn as documented.
DUPLICATOR.name: Duplicator
DUPLICATOR.zh_description: 获得 DuplicationPower 1——本回合你打出的下一张牌额外打出 1 次；回合结束移除。使用后 DUPLICATION_POWER:1 同帧可见，下一张攻击双结算（如 Bash+ 双结算）；药水消费后 DuplicationPower 随回合结束消失。

ENTROPIC_BREW.description: fill every empty potion slot with a random potion.
ENTROPIC_BREW.name: Entropic Brew
ENTROPIC_BREW.zh_description: 用随机药水填满所有空药水栏。

ESSENCE_OF_DARKNESS.description: channel 1 Dark orb per orb slot you have.
ESSENCE_OF_DARKNESS.name: Essence of Darkness
ESSENCE_OF_DARKNESS.zh_description: 每个充能球槽引导 1 个暗球。

EXPLOSIVE_AMPOULE.description: deal 10 damage to ALL enemies (automatic multi-target; do not send a target id).
EXPLOSIVE_AMPOULE.name: Explosive Ampoule
EXPLOSIVE_AMPOULE.zh_description: 对全体敌人造成 10 点伤害（自动多目标，不要发送目标 id）。

FAIRY_IN_A_BOTTLE.description: when you would die, this is discarded instead and you heal to 30% Max HP (minimum 1). Consumed when killed at HP 1 by start-of-turn self-damage — HP set to ~29.6% of Max, consistent with the 30%-Max rule; potion vanishes from belt same state read.
FAIRY_IN_A_BOTTLE.name: Fairy in a Bottle
FAIRY_IN_A_BOTTLE.zh_description: 将死时改为弃掉此药水并回复至最大 HP 的 30%（最少 1 点）。在 HP 1 被回合开始自伤击杀时触发——HP 置为 Max 的 ~29.6%，与 30% Max 规则吻合；药水同帧从药槽消失。

FLEX_POTION.description: Apply FlexPotionPower +5 Strength — lose 5 Strength at end of this turn (temporary). Reptile Trinket-class relics add further same-turn Str if owned. Live run-42 ThievingHopper T3: +5 temp Str burst closed the escape-clock fight.
FLEX_POTION.name: Flex Potion
FLEX_POTION.zh_description: 获得 FlexPotionPower +5 力量——本回合结束时失去 5 力量（临时力量）。

FORTIFIER.description: gain Block equal to 2× your current Block (your Block becomes 3×).
FORTIFIER.name: Fortifier
FORTIFIER.zh_description: 获得等同当前格挡 2 倍的格挡（格挡变为 3 倍）。

FOUL_POTION.description: In combat: deal 12 damage to EVERY non-pet creature INCLUDING you (suicide-class at low HP; self-damage triggers Rupture). In a Merchant room: gain 100 Gold. In FakeMerchant event: starts the FakeMerchant fight — never use there. Run-42 event (Potion Courier) offered x3; at 13 HP combat use was suicide — declined for a rare potion line instead.
FOUL_POTION.name: Foul Potion
FOUL_POTION.zh_description: 战斗中——对每个非宠物生物（含你自己）造成 12 点伤害；商人房间——获得 100 金币；FakeMerchant 事件——触发伪商人战斗。战斗用法=同窗 AoE 工具——12 伤可直接带走 12 HP 千足虫段并铺垫 Thunderclap 收头；自伤触发 Rupture（按 Amount +力）。伪商人房绝不可用（战斗条款）——留给真商人房 +100 金是经济线。

FYSH_OIL.description: +1 Strength and +1 Dexterity for the combat. STRENGTH_POWER +1 and DEXTERITY_POWER:1 appear same state read on use; Dex +1 raises subsequent card-block values by 1 each (Defend 5→6 class) same combat. Usage-timing variant attested: a later decode lists Fysh Oil as anytime/self with the same immediate +1/+1 — verify timing per build.
FYSH_OIL.name: Fysh Oil
FYSH_OIL.zh_description: 本场战斗 +1 力量 +1 敏捷。使用后同帧 STRENGTH_POWER +1 与 DEXTERITY_POWER:1；敏捷 +1 使后续卡牌挡值各 +1（Defend 5→6 级）同战生效。使用时机存在异文：另有解码记为「随时/自身」、同样立刻 +1/+1——按 build 核实时机。

GAMBLER_S_BREW.description: discard any number of hand cards, then draw that many.
GAMBLER_S_BREW.name: Gambler's Brew
GAMBLER_S_BREW.zh_description: 弃置任意数量手牌，然后抽取等量牌。

GIGANTIFICATION_POTION.description: Apply GigantificationPower 1 — your next powered Attack card this combat deals x3 damage; consumed by that attack. Live run-42: stacks multiplicatively with Weak x0.75 and Vuln x1.5 — Bludgeon (32+6 Str)x0.75x1.5x3 = 86 live, exact-kill on 86-HP Rocket.
GIGANTIFICATION_POTION.name: Gigantification Potion
GIGANTIFICATION_POTION.zh_description: 获得 GigantificationPower 1——本场战斗你打出的下一张有源攻击牌造成 ×3 伤害；被该次攻击消耗。

LIQUID_MEMORIES.description: choose 1 card from your discard pile; add it to hand and it is free this turn. Unusable when the discard pile is empty — played with an empty discard the potion is consumed with NO card_choice and no effect (total whiff). Check piles before use.
LIQUID_MEMORIES.name: Liquid Memories
LIQUID_MEMORIES.zh_description: 从弃牌堆选 1 张牌加入手牌，本回合免费。弃牌堆为空时不可用——空弃牌堆打出时药水被消耗但**无选牌界面、无任何效果**（完全空耗）。使用前先确认 piles。

OROBIC_ACID.description: add 1 random Attack, 1 random Skill, 1 random Power from your character card pool to hand; all 3 are free this turn.
OROBIC_ACID.name: Orobic Acid
OROBIC_ACID.zh_description: 从角色卡池随机攻击、技能、能力牌各 1 张加入手牌；3 张本回合均免费。

POTION_OF_BINDING.description: apply 1 Weak and 1 Vulnerable to ALL enemies.
POTION_OF_BINDING.name: Potion of Binding
POTION_OF_BINDING.zh_description: 对全体敌人施加 1 层 Weak 与 1 层 Vulnerable。

POT_OF_GHOULS.name: Pot of Ghouls
POT_OF_GHOULS.zh_description: 向手牌加入 2 张 Soul。

POWDERED_DEMISE.description: apply DemisePower 9 to the target — the target takes 9 unblockable, unpowered damage at the end of each of its turns. Run-41 live: killed a 4-HP Exoskeleton end-of-turn after it had already attacked; a kill-timer potion for escape-clock and HP-wall fights, not a block tool.
POWDERED_DEMISE.name: Powdered Demise
POWDERED_DEMISE.zh_description: 施加 DemisePower 9——目标每个自身回合结束时受到 9 点不可格挡、无来源伤害。

POWER_POTION.description: Choose 1 of 3 distinct Power cards from your character card pool (may skip); add to hand, free this turn. Live run-42 InfestedPrism: offered Dark Embrace / Unmovable / Cruelty — took Cruelty (CRUELTY_POWER:25 = +25% attack damage vs Vulnerable targets).
POWER_POTION.name: Power Potion
POWER_POTION.zh_description: 从角色卡池生成 3 张不同能力牌中选 1 张（可跳过）；加入手牌，本回合免费。

RADIANT_TINCTURE.description: gain 1 Energy now; apply RadiancePower 3 — +1 Energy on each of your next 3 energy resets.
RADIANT_TINCTURE.name: Radiant Tincture
RADIANT_TINCTURE.zh_description: 立即获得 1 能量；获得 RadiancePower 3——接下来 3 次能量重置时各 +1 能量。

REGEN_POTION.description: Gain 5 Regen on use (heal 5 at start of each of your turns, stacks decrement). Uncommon. LIVE run-40: held on belt through Act2 as the HP-rail reserve; not spent — died with it at Entomancer.
REGEN_POTION.name: Regen Potion
REGEN_POTION.source: md:potions.md:L63; md:potions_zh.md:L63; codex:potions/REGEN_POTION; run-40 live fold 2026-09-18

SHACKLING_POTION.description: apply ShacklingPotionPower 7 to ALL enemies — temporary −7 Strength, lost at end of their turn.
SHACKLING_POTION.name: Shackling Potion
SHACKLING_POTION.zh_description: 对全体敌人施加 ShacklingPotionPower 7——临时 −7 力量，其回合结束时失去。

SHIP_IN_A_BOTTLE.description: gain 10 Block; apply BlockNextTurnPower 10 — the first time your Block is cleared, gain 10 Block again (once).
SHIP_IN_A_BOTTLE.name: Ship in a Bottle
SHIP_IN_A_BOTTLE.zh_description: 获得 10 格挡；获得 BlockNextTurnPower 10——你的格挡首次被清除时再次获得 10 格挡（仅一次）。

SKILL_POTION.description: Choose 1 of 3 distinct Skill cards from your character card pool (may skip); add to hand, free this turn. Common. LIVE runs 38+40: run-38 picked Impervious (+30 block) vs elite SWOOP; run-40 card_choice offered SHRUG_IT_OFF / ONE_TWO_PUNCH / PRIMAL_FORCE — picked Shrug It Off (0-cost that turn, Unmovable doubled 8→16) vs Entomancer bees. Lethal-intent potion: spend when incoming exceeds hand block ceiling.
SKILL_POTION.name: Skill Potion
SKILL_POTION.zh_description: 从你的角色卡池 3 张不同技能牌中选 1（可跳过）；加入手牌，本回合免费。run-38 实时：card_choice 覆盖层给出 IMPERVOUS/TRUE_GRIT/PRIMAL_FORCE；选 Impervious——免费 +30 挡在 HP 24、零防御手牌的回合挡下精英 SWOOP 19。致命意图药水：当来袭超过手牌挡上限时使用。

SNECKO_OIL.description: draw 7; randomize the cost of every non-X card currently in your hand.
SNECKO_OIL.name: Snecko Oil
SNECKO_OIL.zh_description: 抽 7 张；随机化手牌中所有非 X 费卡牌的费用。

SOLDIER_S_STEW.description: every card with the Strike tag in your combat piles gains +1 Replay for this combat. The Replay behaves as a one-shot charge per card at use-time — strikes already in hand/draw when the potion is drunk replay once when played; strikes drawn later in the same combat resolve a single time.
SOLDIER_S_STEW.name: Soldier's Stew
SOLDIER_S_STEW.zh_description: 本场战斗内你战斗牌堆中所有含 Strike 标签的卡牌 +1 次 Replay。Replay 表现为用药时对各张卡的一次性充能 —— 用药时已在手牌/抽牌堆中的打击牌打出时额外结算一次；战斗后期才抽到的打击只结算一次。

SPEED_POTION.description: apply SpeedPotionPower +5 Dexterity for the current turn; lose the 5 Dexterity at end of turn (temporary). Run-41 live: Defend 5→10 and Shrug 8→13 under the buff; one-turn burst block — spend it on the turn the lethal intent lands, not earlier.
SPEED_POTION.name: Speed Potion
SPEED_POTION.zh_description: 获得 SpeedPotionPower +5 敏捷——本回合结束时失去 5 敏捷（临时敏捷）。

STABLE.description: Stable Serum: Retain your Hand for 2 turns (cards stay in hand end of turn). Uncommon. LIVE run-40: held as belt reserve through Act2; retain does not add block — not a lethal-intent answer by itself.
STABLE.name: Stable Serum

STABLE_SERUM.description: apply RetainHandPower 2 — your hand is not flushed at end of turn for the next 2 turns.
STABLE_SERUM.name: Stable Serum
STABLE_SERUM.zh_description: 获得 RetainHandPower 2——接下来 2 个回合结束时不弃手牌。

TOUCH_OF_INSANITY.description: Choose 1 hand card that costs Energy or stars; it costs 0 for the rest of combat. Usage: hand_select overlay choose(index) THEN proceed. Live run-42 BygoneEffigy: Bash made 0-cost rest of combat — free Bash+Vuln every draw for the kill window.
TOUCH_OF_INSANITY.name: Touch of Insanity
TOUCH_OF_INSANITY.zh_description: 选择手牌中 1 张消耗能量或星星的卡牌；本场战斗其费用为 0。
